book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge—

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you—

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you?

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, it’s good for a man to remain as he is.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Are you bound to a wife? Don’t seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don’t seek a wife.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: But I say this, brothers: the time is short. From now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: and those who weep, as though they didn’t weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn’t rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn’t possess;

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: This I say for your own benefit, not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: My defense to those who examine me is this:

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Have we no right to eat and to drink?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn’t eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn’t drink from the flock’s milk?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn’t the law also say the same thing?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” Is it for the oxen that God cares,

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?

book_name: Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians
text: If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? Nevertheless we didn’t use this right, but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the Good News of Christ.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: For the body is not one member, but many.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: But now they are many members, but one body.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God, for no one understands, but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but even more that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in the world, and none of them is without meaning.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: If then I don’t know the meaning of the language, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: What should I do? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: If any man speaks in another language, let there be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Let two or three of the prophets speak, and let the others discern.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all may be exhorted.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says,

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Let all things be done decently and in order.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

book_name: 1 Corinthians
text: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: When I therefore planned this, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are being saved and in those who perish:

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also believe, and therefore we also speak,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also through Jesus, and will present us with you.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.

book_name: Paul’s Second Letter to the Corinthians
text: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

book_name: Peter’s Second Letter
text: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,

book_name: John
text: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

book_name: John
text: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.

book_name: John
text: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”

book_name: John
text: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!

book_name: John
text: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”

book_name: John
text: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.

book_name: John
text: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”

book_name: John
text: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”

book_name: John
text: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”

book_name: John
text: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”

book_name: John
text: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”

book_name: John
text: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

book_name: John
text: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.

book_name: The Good News According to John
text: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.

book_name: Matthew
text: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

book_name: Matthew
text: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.

book_name: Matthew
text: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

book_name: Matthew
text: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.

book_name: Matthew
text: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.

book_name: Matthew
text: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

book_name: Matthew
text: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”

book_name: Matthew
text: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.

book_name: Matthew
text: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”

book_name: Matthew
text: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”

book_name: Matthew
text: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.

book_name: Matthew
text: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”

book_name: Matthew
text: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

book_name: Matthew
text: Then the disciples came and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?”

book_name: Matthew
text: But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.

book_name: Matthew
text: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”

book_name: Matthew
text: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”

book_name: Matthew
text: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?

book_name: Matthew
text: Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly and then out of the body?

book_name: Matthew
text: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.

book_name: Matthew
text: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.

book_name: Matthew
text: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”

book_name: Matthew
text: Jesus went out from there and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.

book_name: Matthew
text: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”

book_name: Matthew
text: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”

book_name: Matthew
text: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”

book_name: Matthew
text: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;

book_name: Matthew
text: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

book_name: Matthew
text: They all ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.

book_name: Matthew
text: Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.

book_name: Matthew
text: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Peter answered and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But this kind doesn’t go out except by prayer and fasting.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

book_name: Matthew
text: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.

book_name: Matthew
text: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.

book_name: Matthew
text: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”

book_name: Matthew
text: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”

book_name: Matthew
text: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When he had begun to settle, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But because he couldn’t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the debt.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Then his lord called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”

book_name: Matthew
text: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.

book_name: Matthew
text: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh’?

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce and divorce her?”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”

book_name: Matthew
text: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.

book_name: Matthew
text: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”

book_name: Matthew
text: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.

book_name: Matthew
text: “For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.

book_name: Matthew
text: When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

book_name: Matthew
text: He went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.

book_name: Matthew
text: He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went their way.

book_name: Matthew
text: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.

book_name: Matthew
text: About the eleventh hour he went out and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?’

book_name: Matthew
text: “They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ “He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’

book_name: Matthew
text: “When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.’

book_name: Matthew
text: “When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.

book_name: Matthew
text: When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.

book_name: Matthew
text: When they received it, they murmured against the master of the household,

book_name: Matthew
text: saying, ‘These last have spent one hour, and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’

book_name: Matthew
text: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Didn’t you agree with me for a denarius?

book_name: Matthew
text: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.

book_name: Matthew
text: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’

book_name: Matthew
text: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”

book_name: Matthew
text: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,

book_name: Matthew
text: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,

book_name: Matthew
text: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”

book_name: Matthew
text: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.

book_name: Matthew
text: He said to her, “What do you want?” She said to him, “Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.”

book_name: Matthew
text: But Jesus answered, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?” They said to him, “We are able.”

book_name: Matthew
text: He said to them, “You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with; but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give, but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.”

book_name: Matthew
text: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.

book_name: Matthew
text: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

book_name: Matthew
text: It shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.

book_name: Matthew
text: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,

book_name: Matthew
text: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

book_name: Matthew
text: Jesus entered into the temple of God and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

book_name: Matthew
text: He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a den of robbers!”

book_name: Matthew
text: The lame and the blind came to him in the temple, and he healed them.

book_name: Matthew
text: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and camped there.

book_name: Matthew
text: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.

book_name: Matthew
text: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit from you forever!” Immediately the fig tree withered away.

book_name: Matthew
text: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree immediately wither away?”

book_name: Matthew
text: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it would be done.

book_name: Matthew
text: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”

book_name: Matthew
text: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”

book_name: Matthew
text: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

book_name: Matthew
text: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

book_name: Matthew
text: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.”

book_name: Matthew
text: They answered Jesus, and said, “We don’t know.” He also said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.

book_name: Matthew
text: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’

book_name: Matthew
text: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.

book_name: Matthew
text: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go.

book_name: Matthew
text: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into God’s Kingdom before you.

book_name: Matthew
text: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn’t even repent afterward, that you might believe him.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: After them all, the woman died.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated.’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by him who has been living in it.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by him who sits on it.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the tombs of the righteous,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But he who endures to the end will be saved.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days!

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter nor on a Sabbath,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: for then there will be great suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘There!’ don’t believe it.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: For false christs and false prophets will arise, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Behold, I have told you beforehand.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “If therefore they tell you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ don’t go out; or ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures gather together.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “But immediately after the suffering of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable: When its branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that he is near, even at the doors.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,

book_name: The Good News According to Matthew
text: and will cut him in pieces and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: All the city was gathered together at the door.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.

book_name: The Good News According to Mark
text: No one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”

book_name: Romans
text: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

book_name: Romans
text: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

book_name: Romans
text: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

book_name: Romans
text: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Romans
text: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Romans
text: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Romans
text: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

book_name: Paul’s Letter to the Romans
text: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
